title: Finite-Window Singularity Audits and Local-to-Clean Defect Transfer for Navier-Stokes
summary: We develop a finite-window audit and transfer framework for the local regularity problem of the three-dimensional incompressible Navier--Stokes equations. The paper has two logically separate components. First, a finite-scale critical ledger estimate shows that a persistent non-CKN branch cannot survive without cumulative untaxed critical supply or accumulated localization leakage. Second, a local-to-clean transfer theorem shows how a clean finite-window anti-phantom gap gives a localized coercive estimate for Navier--Stokes defect packages, provided three structural inputs hold:…
